gloss: to be settled; to come together; to be organized

definitions.gloss: to come together; to be gathered
definitions.explanation: For scattered things to become collected or unified.

definitions.gloss: to be organized; to take shape
definitions.explanation: For ideas, plans, or work to become coherent and organized.

definitions.gloss: to be settled; to reach agreement
definitions.explanation: For negotiations or discussions to reach a conclusion.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}がやっと{纏|まと}まった。
{契約|けいやく}の{話|はなし}が{纏|まと}まった。
{纏|まと}まったお{金|かね}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: I need a substantial amount of money.

examples.japanese: グループが{一|ひと}つに{纏|まと}まった。
examples.english: The group came together as one.

examples.japanese: {纏|まと}まった{時間|じかん}がとれない。
examples.english: I can't get a substantial chunk of time.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}が{纏|まと}まって{入|はい}った。
{考|かんが}えが{纏|まと}まらない。
{計画|けいかく}がやっと{纏|まと}まった。
{文章|ぶんしょう}が{纏|まと}まっていない。
examples.english: The writing is not well organized.

examples.japanese: {デザイン|でざいん}が{纏|まと}まってきた。
{商談|しょうだん}が{纏|まと}まった。
{合意|ごうい}が{纏|まと}まるまで{待|ま}つ。
examples.english: Wait until an agreement is reached.

examples.japanese: {縁談|えんだん}が{纏|まと}まった。
{議論|ぎろん}が{纏|まと}まらなかった。
examples.english: The discussion didn't reach a conclusion.

examples.japanese: {条件|じょうけん}が{纏|まと}まれば{契約|けいやく}する。
examples.english: If the terms are agreed upon, we'll sign the contract.

notes:
{纏|まと}まる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning for things to come together or be resolved.

TRANSITIVE PAIR: {纏|まと}める (to put together, summarize)
- {纏|まと}まる: The plan comes together.
- {纏|まと}める: I put together the plan.

ASPECT (ている):
{纏|まと}まっている indicates things are organized or a matter has been settled.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [opinion/plan]が{纏|まと}まる — [opinion/plan] comes together
- [negotiation]が{纏|まと}まる — [negotiation] is concluded

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {話|はなし}が{纏|まと}まる (discussion is settled)
- {考|かんが}えが{纏|まと}まる (thoughts become organized)
- {纏|まと}まった{金額|きんがく} (substantial amount)

ADJECTIVAL USE:
{纏|まと}まった + noun means "substantial" or "considerable":
- {纏|まと}まったお{金|かね} (substantial money)
- {纏|まと}まった{時間|じかん} (significant chunk of time)
